failedStart.label: 002-gh-default-branch
failedStart.reason: PowerShell script-scope Repository variable was overwritten by a parsed public repository object, producing an invalid working directory before Process.Start.

preservation: The executed initial controller and observer remain unchanged and will not be replayed. Successful 001 bytes are reused, not re-requested.
finiteContinuation: One fresh isolated-module controller may start the previously unstarted read-only branch request and immutable source capture under fresh guards. No product/native correctness, measurement, candidate edit or closed-budget reopening.
